prompt.text:
Implement three shipment-accounting functions and export exactly `{ calculateOutstanding, calculateExceptions, calculateUnexplained }` using CommonJS. Every numeric input must be a non-negative safe integer; malformed input throws `TypeError`. `calculateOutstanding(received, completed)` returns `received - completed` and throws `RangeError` if completed exceeds received. `calculateExceptions(delayed, damaged, waived)` returns their sum. `calculateUnexplained(data)` accepts exactly the relevant values in an object `{ received, completed, delayed, damaged, waived }`, calculates outstanding units, and subtracts documented exceptions. It throws `RangeError` if the exceptions exceed outstanding units. Zero values are valid. The input object must not be mutated.

Return only the complete source file; do not include Markdown fences or prose.
